title: Le Grand Verre (Nothing of Its Own)
summary: Two transparent CSS panes that own no image and render only a backdrop-filter of the room behind them; remove the room and the glass proves it kept nothing.
mechanism: CSS backdrop-filter on background-transparent panes (attested via getComputedStyle) whose only pixels are the layer behind, plus per-visit crypto.getRandomValues crack generation; toggling the backdrop layer empties the glass.
references: Marcel Duchamp, The Bride Stripped Bare by Her Bachelors, Even (The Large Glass), 1915-1923
the 1927 accidental cracking, kept as completion 'by chance'
